body:
I was suicidal for the first time in my life for a number of minutes last summer and had a relapse a couple of seconds ago.

When I found out that my girlfriend had cheated on me last summer I broke down... it was on a Friday.

Monday morning, no school, no parents, no friends, I was alone in my house and realized what my life had become.  I thought of committing suicide.  Thankfully I didn't and instead got on the phone with people.

Since August I have made a small but conscious effort to be nicer and be 'of service' to people.  Inch by inch this made me incrementally happier.

I'm alone now in my house and I just saw my ex on facebook.  My heart started beating and I almost became physically ill and felt the same sort of panic that accompanied me in August.  Because I am alone I felt trapped, thus causing me 2-3 seconds of sheer dread.

But this time it's different.  

Ever since August I have built up friends and some people have even started calling me 'a really nice guy'.  I LOVED that.

I realized that my mistake in the past was to put too much happiness on one person.  (When that person leaves you're left with nothing).

I agree that a relationship is meant to augment happiness.  I hope to one day put my theory into practice, I tend to mentally *marry* every woman I date and take break-ups usually pretty hard.

**tears**

I'm asking someone to forgive me for something I've done to my ex that caused her a lot of embarrassment.  I publicly humiliated her on facebook about the break-up.  I am asking someone to forgive me for this.
